# Data contracts

<!-- Generated by `python -m beauty_expansion.contracts --markdown > docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md`. Do not edit by hand: edit src/beauty_expansion/contracts.py. -->

Every file in `data/processed/` has a contract: its grain, key and columns. The pipeline refuses
to write a file that breaks it, and CI checks that this page matches the code.

**Units from names:** `_eur` euros · `_meur` millions of euros · `_km` kilometres · `_pct` percent 0–100 · `_rate`, `_share`, `_margin`, `_cagr` fraction 0–1 · `_per_100k` per 100,000 inhabitants.

## `kpis_by_country.csv`

- **Grain:** one country
- **Key:** `country_code`
- **Produced by:** `analysis/kpis.py`
- **Countries:** AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO

| Column | Type | Unit | Range / values | Empty allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `country_code` | str | ISO 3166-1 | AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO |  | country |
| `market_size_meur` | float | M EUR | 0 –  |  | household personal-care spending (Eurostat CP131) |
| `spend_per_capita_eur` | float | EUR | 0 –  |  | personal-care spending per inhabitant |
| `market_cagr` | float | fraction | -0.5 – 0.5 |  | growth of market size, 2019 to latest year |
| `personal_care_share_pct` | float | % | 0 – 100 |  | personal care as a share of household spending |
| `sephora_fr_market_share` | float | fraction | 0 – 1 | yes | Sephora revenue / market (France only) |
| `leader_store_share` | float | fraction | 0 – 1 |  | leading chain's share of selective stores |
| `leader_brand` | str |  |  |  | leading selective chain by store count |
| `relative_price_index` | float | FR=100 | 20 – 500 |  | Eurostat price level index, personal care |
| `scraped_price_index` | float | FR=100 | 20 – 500 | yes | median online price vs France |
| `scraped_products` | float | count | 0 –  | yes | products matched in every scraped country |
| `price_passthrough` | float | fraction | 0 – 1 |  | share of the price level gap passed to prices |
| `effective_price_index` | float | FR=100 | 20 – 500 |  | price index used in the margin |
| `vat_standard_rate` | float | fraction | 0 – 0.3 |  | standard VAT rate |
| `hub_distance_km` | float | km | 0 – 3000 |  | mean road distance from selective stores to nearest EU hub |
| `trade_friction` | float | points | 0 – 10 |  | customs + currency friction (0 = none) |
| `catalogue_eligible_pct` | float | % | 0 – 100 |  | share of French SKUs sellable in the country |
| `gross_margin_post_tax` | float | fraction | 0 – 1 |  | gross margin after VAT, logistics and customs |
| `catchment_density_per_100k` | float | per 100k | 0 –  |  | selective stores within 10 km of top-5 cities |
| `selective_stores_per_100k_national` | float | per 100k | 0 –  |  | selective stores per inhabitant, whole country |
| `prime_rent_eur_m2` | float | EUR/m²/year | 0 –  |  | prime high-street rent (Cushman & Wakefield) |
| `labour_cost_retail_eur_h` | float | EUR/hour | 0 –  |  | hourly labour cost, retail (Eurostat) |
| `corporate_tax_rate` | float | fraction | 0 – 0.5 |  | headline corporate income tax |
| `population` | float | people | 0 –  |  | population on 1 January (Eurostat) |

## `business_case_summary.csv`

- **Grain:** one candidate × scenario
- **Key:** `country_code`, `scenario`
- **Produced by:** `analysis/business_case.py`
- **Countries:** AT, FI, IE, NL, NO

| Column | Type | Unit | Range / values | Empty allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `country_code` | str | ISO 3166-1 | AT, FI, IE, NL, NO |  | country |
| `scenario` | str |  | pessimistic, base, optimistic |  | sales scenario |
| `store_revenue_meur` | float | M EUR | 0 –  |  | revenue of one mature store |
| `store_ebitda_margin` | float | fraction | -1 – 1 |  | EBITDA / revenue of one mature store |
| `payback_years` | float | years | 0 – 10 | yes | store payback; empty = never within 10 years |
| `plan_revenue_2029_meur` | float | M EUR | 0 –  |  | network revenue in 2029 |
| `plan_capex_meur` | float | M EUR | 0 –  |  | fit-out + opening costs + opening inventory |
| `plan_npv_meur` | float | M EUR |  |  | NPV of the 15-store plan at the WACC |
| `demand_factor` | float | ratio | 0 – 3 |  | local demand vs France (after elasticity) |
| `assortment_factor` | float | ratio | 0 – 1 |  | share of the catalogue sellable |
| `competition_factor` | float | ratio | 0 – 3 |  | competition adjustment |
| `go` | bool |  |  |  | passes all three decision checks |

## `stores.csv`

- **Grain:** one competitor store (OpenStreetMap feature)

- **Produced by:** `extract/osm.py`
- **Countries:** AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO
- **Note:** Continental Europe only: overseas territories are removed (config.EUROPE_BBOX).

| `country_code` | str | ISO 3166-1 | AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO |  | country |
| `brand` | str |  | 30 listed values |  | chain |
| `segment` | str |  | selective, drugstore |  | competitor type |
| `city` | str |  |  | yes | addr:city tag |
| `lat` | float | degrees | 34.0 – 72.0 |  | latitude |

| `km_to_nearest_hub` | float | km | 0 – 3000 |  | road distance to nearest EU hub |
| `nearest_hub` | str |  |  |  | hub name (data/manual/logistics_hubs.csv) |

## `fragrance_market.csv` *(planned)*

- **Grain:** one country × year
- **Key:** `country_code`, `year`
- **Produced by:** `extract/comext.py (issue #2)`
- **Countries:** AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO
- **Note:** Eurostat Comext HS 3303. Apparent consumption = imports - exports (corrects NL re-exports). Norway may be missing (not in Comext): leave it out rather than invent it.

| Column | Type | Unit | Range / values | Empty allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `country_code` | str | ISO 3166-1 | AT, FI, FR, IE, NL, NO |  | country |
| `year` | int | year | 2015 – 2030 |  | calendar year |
| `imports_eur` | float | EUR | 0 –  |  | imports of HS 3303 from the world |
| `exports_eur` | float | EUR | 0 –  |  | exports of HS 3303 to the world |
| `apparent_consumption_eur` | float | EUR |  |  | imports minus exports (can be negative for a re-export hub) |
| `per_capita_eur` | float | EUR |  |  | apparent consumption per inhabitant |
| `source` | str |  |  |  | dataset id or URL |
